name: cavemio-inline-rewrite
title: Inline Rewrite
description: Drag a dial to rewrite a paragraph in place, with shared words gliding into position.

cavemio.usage:
import { InlineRewrite } from "@/components/inline-rewrite";

<InlineRewrite label="Length" description="Adjust how much detail the paragraph includes." defaultValue={1} versions={[{ label: "Shorter", text: "Fresh beans, delivered." }, { label: "Original", text: "Fresh beans from small roasters, delivered every two weeks." }]} />
cavemio.accessibility: The visible label names the keyboard-accessible slider; arrow keys, Home and End select versions. Optional description text appears in an info tooltip on hover or focus and describes the slider for assistive technology. Status updates are announced politely. Reduced motion changes text in place and disables slider movement.
cavemio.previewNote: Uses local demo data; no AI service or network requests.

props.name: versions
props.description: Required. Available rewrite versions, including their labels and text.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional. Called when the selection changes.

props.name: originalIndex
props.description: Optional. The version the counts compare against. Defaults to the one chosen first.

props.name: onRewrite
props.description: Optional. Asynchronous rewrite handler. Resolve with the replacement text.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional. Visible heading and accessible name for the slider, e.g. "Tone".

props.name: description
props.description: Optional. Help text, shown beside the heading in an info tooltip.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Optional. Let new words glow for a moment after each rewrite.
